console.title: Mid-Market Solution Blueprint Console
console.tagline: Discovery turns into a demoable architecture, a human gate, and time-to-live impact. Accounts, blueprints, and impact are synthetic demo data for a Solutions Engineer portfolio walkthrough. No real Attio workspace, no logins, no API calls.

accounts.name: Lumenboard
accounts.motion: Outbound + product-led revenue. 41 reps across sales, SDR, and CS.
accounts.pain: CRM lives in spreadsheets. Two CRM attempts failed in 24 months; pipeline data lands in Slack threads and email.
accounts.stubNote: Written from discovery notes. GTM stack is the standard Slack + email + billing shape for mid-market.

blueprint.title: Data model
blueprint.intro: Map the messy spreadsheets onto Attio objects. This is the architectural core of the solution.

items.label: Companies, People, Deals
items.detail: Three core objects replace the spreadsheet tabs. Deals attach to Companies; People attach to Companies and Deals.

items.label: Health score on Companies
items.detail: Custom attribute combines product usage, billing status, and deal stage for the CS motion.

items.label: Stage governance on Deals
items.detail: Fixed pipeline with exit criteria so stage names stop drifting between teams.

blueprint.title: Workflows
blueprint.intro: No-code workflow builder keeps the CRM current without a data team.

items.label: Email sync into People records
items.detail: Inbound and outbound email activity appears on the right People record, so Slack threads stop being the source of truth.

items.label: Deal stage automation
items.detail: Workflow moves Deals on signature and billing events, with a manual approval step for exceptions.

blueprint.title: API / MCP
blueprint.intro: Live context for GTM agents without brittle exports.

items.label: REST API + webhooks
items.detail: Stripe billing events push into Attio; pipeline changes push to the internal Slack channel.

items.label: MCP server for agents
items.detail: Revenue agents query live deal and account context instead of stale spreadsheet snapshots.

blueprint.title: Reporting
blueprint.intro: The pipeline report the CEO actually reads, standing on the data model.

items.label: Pipeline + activity reporting
items.detail: Forecast by stage, rep, and segment from the unified data model, not a weekly manual export.

blueprint.title: Migration
blueprint.intro: Spreadsheet to go-live in one SE-owned cutover.

items.label: Import template + field map
items.detail: Columns map to Attio attributes before any rows move. No guessing at import time.

items.label: Sandbox validation
items.detail: Counts and samples validated in a sandbox before the production cutover.

migration.summary: Current data is clean spreadsheets. Migration is covered inside the onboarding plan: template, field map, sandbox validation.

items.label: Import template from the spreadsheet
items.detail: Covered in the onboarding plan.

items.label: Field map: columns to Attio attributes
items.detail: Covered in the onboarding plan.

items.label: Sandbox validation before cutover
items.detail: Covered in the onboarding plan.

escalate.summary: Commercial: $78k ACV, annual prepay, procurement intake pending. The AE owns packaging; the technical blueprint stays ready and the SE re-engages at technical handoff.

accounts.name: Corvid Analytics
accounts.pain: 40,000 rows of historical deals with duplicate owners, orphaned line items, and no stage governance. Reporting has been wrong for two quarters.
accounts.stubNote: Written from discovery notes. This account is the historical-data migration path.

items.label: Companies, People, Deals

items.label: Custom fields from legacy columns

blueprint.title: Workflows
blueprint.intro: Stage governance is rebuildable, but only after the rows are clean.

items.label: Stage governance map

blueprint.title: API / MCP

blueprint.title: Migration
blueprint.intro: Historical data is the single biggest risk. The SE owns the checklist.

items.label: Checklist gates go-live
items.detail: Go-live stays blocked until the migration checklist completes. No silent import.

migration.summary: Go-live is blocked until every checklist item completes. Each item is a pre-recorded synthetic finding.

items.label: Export all 40,000 deal rows

items.label: Map legacy stages to the Attio pipeline

items.label: Map custom fields to Attio attributes

items.label: Sandbox import and validate counts

items.label: Re-run workflow triggers on imported records
items.detail: Method: workflow builder trigger re-run.
